answer: Every claim must survive an echo auction: strangers bid to re-perform a random slice of the claimed job, payout unlocking only when the echo matches. Echoers are paid from the claimant's bond, so a fleet's clones bid against each other for one pool, and the k-th clone pays k times the first. Scores post to a public mesa board; below the median, a claim forfeits its bond. The payout sits in a lotus vault opening one petal per epoch while the score stays above median, so clones must keep winning or their vaults seal. One honest agent wins once; a fleet pays an auction war against itself.
